verdict.rationale: Render explicitly markets 'reliable agents and background processes at scale, without wiring up queues, workers, and retry logic' and offers YAML-based infra-as-code, matching the story's intent at a high level. However there is no concrete documentation of a durable-execution/workflow engine (state checkpointing, step retries, workflow versioning) beyond this marketing line, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of durable workflow behavior. Missing for 10: technical detail on workflow durability/retry semantics, workflow versioning docs, independent verification of the 'no wiring' claim.
